context: A dad tells jokes to his young son to cheer him up
purpose: Teach: 判ら/ヘルプ/あいまい/ステキ/ジョーク/ボリューム/終始/輝く

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: どうした翔、そんな顔して。パパが軽いジョークでも言ってあげようか？
lines.en: What's wrong, Sho, with that face? Want Dad to tell you a light joke?
lines.style: Warm fatherly tone, gentle teasing, slightly playful pitch lift on the offer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん…でもパパのジョーク、いつも意味が判らないんだもん。
lines.en: Yeah... but Dad, your jokes, I never understand what they mean.
lines.style: Sulky child voice, soft mumble, drawn-out vowels showing reluctance and pout.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: そんなあいまいな返事しないで。今日のは絶対ステキな話だぞ？
lines.en: Don't give me such a vague answer. Today's is definitely a wonderful story, okay?
lines.style: Mock-offended dad voice, rising confident energy, exaggerated pride at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ほんと？じゃあ聞く。でもつまんなかったらヘルプ呼ぶよ。
lines.en: Really? Then I'll listen. But if it's boring, I'll call for help.
lines.style: Reluctantly curious child, small giggle creeping in, mock-threatening final line.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: よし、ボリューム上げていくぞ！パンはパンでも食べられないパンは？
lines.en: Alright, turning up the volume! What kind of bread can't you eat?
lines.style: Booming game-show host energy, theatrical buildup, classic dad-joke delivery cadence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: えー…フライパン！パパ、それ前も聞いたよ！
lines.en: Uh... a frying pan! Dad, I've heard that one before!
lines.style: Exasperated but amused child, half-laughing protest, voice cracking with reluctant joy.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ほら、終始ニコニコしてるじゃないか。翔の目はちゃんと輝くんだぞ。
lines.en: See, you've been smiling the whole time. Sho, your eyes really do shine.
lines.style: Soft tender dad voice, warm chuckle, slowing down to a heartfelt closing observation.
